name: comm-scope-monorepo
description: Monorepo for comm-scope — Serial / TCP / UDP traffic monitor for developers

scripts.build: npm run build -w @anthonyfree96/core && npm run build -w comm-scope
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @anthonyfree96/core && npm run typecheck -w @anthonyfree96/core && npm run typecheck -w comm-scope
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build -w comm-scope && npm publish -w comm-scope
